# 1equal

> 1Equal is sports team management software for games, training, player attendance, venues and team expenses. Public pages are at https://1equal.com.

Languages have their own URLs. Signed-in routes such as `/dashboard`, `/demo`, `/login`, `/signup` and `/training` must not be crawled.

## Languages

- [Latviešu](https://1equal.com/)
- [English](https://1equal.com/en)
- [Русский](https://1equal.com/ru)
